info.title: Church Management API
info.description: The church management API. Every request goes to a church's own host, for example https://grace-assembly.yourapp.com/api/v1. Amounts are GHS decimal strings with a _formatted sibling. Enum fields come with a _label sibling.

AddDepartmentMemberRequest.description: Validates adding a member to a department. The member must belong to this church.
AddDepartmentMemberRequest.title: AddDepartmentMemberRequest

EducationalLevel.description: The allowed educational level values, stored as a plain string column (D-017).
EducationalLevel.title: EducationalLevel

EraseMemberRequest.description: Validates an erasure request. The reason is kept in the change log, so it must not contain personal details.
EraseMemberRequest.title: EraseMemberRequest

FamilyRole.description: The allowed family role values, stored as a plain string column (D-017).
FamilyRole.title: FamilyRole

Gender.description: The allowed gender values, stored as a plain string column (D-017).
Gender.title: Gender

MaritalStatus.description: The allowed marital status values, stored as a plain string column (D-017).
MaritalStatus.title: MaritalStatus

MemberStatus.description: The allowed member status values, stored as a plain string column (D-017).
MemberStatus.title: MemberStatus

MembershipType.description: The allowed membership type values, stored as a plain string column (D-017).
MembershipType.title: MembershipType

MilestoneType.description: The allowed milestone type values, stored as a plain string column (D-017).
MilestoneType.title: MilestoneType

RegisterChurchRequest.description:
Validates the sign-up of a new church: its name, web address, member number prefix, first admin and the
code texted to that admin's phone.
RegisterChurchRequest.title: RegisterChurchRequest

RequestChurchOtpRequest.description: Validates the request to text a sign-up code to the phone of the person starting a church.
RequestChurchOtpRequest.title: RequestChurchOtpRequest

RequestOtpRequest.description: Validates a request to be sent a sign-in code.
RequestOtpRequest.title: RequestOtpRequest

StoreFamilyRequest.description: Validates a new family. An optional head must be an existing member of this church.
StoreFamilyRequest.title: StoreFamilyRequest

StoreMemberRequest.description: Validates a new member. The route's policy check has already run, so authorize() lets it through.
StoreMemberRequest.title: StoreMemberRequest

StoreMilestoneRequest.description: Validates a new milestone (baptism, confirmation, ...). It cannot be dated in the future.
StoreMilestoneRequest.title: StoreMilestoneRequest

UpdateFamilyRequest.description:
Validates a family update. The head is changed through the members' roles, not here, so two people
can never both hold the head role.
UpdateFamilyRequest.title: UpdateFamilyRequest

UpdateMemberStatusRequest.description: Validates a status change. The note is the reason kept in the change log.
UpdateMemberStatusRequest.title: UpdateMemberStatusRequest

UploadMemberPhotoRequest.description:
Validates a member photo upload: JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB and 4096 pixels on a side (docs/08).
The file type is read from the file's contents, not from its name or the Content-Type header.
The pixel limit also bounds the memory needed to decode it.
UploadMemberPhotoRequest.title: UploadMemberPhotoRequest
